title: Correct velocity expression
description: Essential Criteria: Student must provide the correct maximum velocity expression(s) for the given charge scenario.

title: Lorentz force application
description: Important Criteria: Student must correctly apply the Lorentz force law to derive the cyclotron radius formula R = mv/(|q|B).

title: Geometric constraint setup
description: Important Criteria: Student must establish the correct geometric relationship between the orbit radius R, the field width d, and the injection point relative to the boundaries.

title: Charge sign consideration
description: Important Criteria: Student must recognize that the maximum velocity differs for positive and negative charges due to opposite deflection directions.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional Criteria: Student should show clear algebraic steps to solve for v from the geometric constraint and radius formula.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: Student may verify that the final velocity expression has correct units (m/s).

title: Incorrect radius formula
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student incorrectly states the cyclotron radius (e.g., R = Bq/(mv) or missing absolute value).

title: Wrong geometric relationship
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student uses an incorrect geometric constraint (e.g., d = R, d = 2R, or wrong trigonometric relationship).

title: Sign error in final answer
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student provides a negative velocity magnitude or confuses the (2±√2) factors between charge signs.
